headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox continued their winning streak, dominating the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0 and 5-3 in two separate games. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance in the first game, while Wilyer Abreu's 2 hits and 2 home runs were not enough to overcome the Red Sox's strong performance in the second game.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Chris Bassitt, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort. Other injured players include JoJo Romero, Brent Rooker, Brice Matthews, Brad Keller, Tommy Troy, Rob Zastryzny, and Drew Millas.

The Kansas City Royals made a roster move, trading RF Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers also made a significant trade, acquiring RHP Lance McCullers Jr., LHP Colton Gordon, and cash from the Houston Astros in exchange for OF Jadyn Fielder.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them their latest defeat. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key three-run homer.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 5-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox took down the Tampa Bay Rays 5-3, securing their win. Wilyer Abreu led the Rays with 2 hits and 2 home runs, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Red Sox's strong performance.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the offense and Jack Dreyer securing the win.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers 15-1, securing a decisive win. Chris Sale led the Braves' pitching effort, throwing 7.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Bassitt Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles right-hander Chris Bassitt has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort. This move comes after he was initially placed on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Royals Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals traded RF Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash on July 18, 2026.
